user.title: Connect to Enki
user.description:
Connect Home Assistant to your Enki account to automatically discover and control your compatible devices.

Supported categories include lights, covers, fans, sensors, security devices, scenarios and more.

Use the same credentials as the Enki mobile application.

polling.title: Polling settings
polling.description:
Choose how often Home Assistant should refresh data from Enki.

Lower values provide faster state updates but generate more requests to Enki cloud services.

Recommended values:
• 30 seconds: security-focused installations
• 60 seconds: general usage
• 300 seconds: monitoring-oriented deployments

You can also configure the refresh interval for each device after it is discovered.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Enki
reconfigure.description:
Update your Enki account credentials and integration settings.

Home Assistant will verify the new credentials before saving them.
